subject: MAP: Capacity reservation and GPU pool sizing — sprint options
messages:
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
To: ops@novamed.com
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 10 Jun 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: MAP: Capacity reservation and GPU pool sizing — sprint options

Hi Alyssa,

Thanks again for the conversation this morning — I wanted to capture a short mutual action plan (MAP) draft that ties evaluation milestones to reservation timing so we can hit the Q3 window Novamed outlined. Key points here are lead times for Dedicated/Private capacity and how we stagger the GPU pool commits to reduce upfront spend while guaranteeing runway.

Summary (short):
- Target: ship pilot inference environment Aug 15, 2025; production ramp begins Sept 8, 2025.
- Suggested commit: two-tranche reservation (Tranche A: 20 T4-equivalent GPUs commit by 2025-06-30; Tranche B: additional 40 GPUs by 2025-08-01).
- Acceptance: QA signoff + SOC2 gating for Private deployment; acceptance window 7 business days after handoff.
- Fallback: If Dedicated capacity delayed beyond 3 weeks, we route to hosted fallback model (quantized variant) with burst credits enabled.

Requests for you:
1) Confirm expected sustained token throughput and 95th pct latencies for inference (example: 3M tokens/day, 95th < 250ms).
2) Approve the tranche dates above or propose alternate commit dates; we need an internal PO/commit by 2025-06-24 to hit Tranche A scheduling.
3) Share any procurement cadence constraints (e.g., finance blackout weeks).

Attached: novamed_map_draft_v1.pdf (MAP draft with milestones), gpu_pool_sizing_model.xlsx (sizing assumptions).

I'll follow up with a one-page commitment checklist if you want to move forward. Ben can scope the engineering acceptance criteria and SLA addendum.

Thanks,
Jonas
Jonas Weber
Account Executive | Redwood Inference

Jonas — thanks, useful summary. A couple quick clarifications before we lock tranche dates:

- Lead time: when you say "20 T4-equivalent GPUs by 2025-06-30" — is that physical on-prem hardware procurement or a dedicated standing pool in Redwood Dedicated? We prefer Dedicated pool (cloud-backed) for faster provisioning.
- Acceptance criteria: can you list the minimal tech gating items we need to clear for Private deployment (networking/VPC peering, KMS integration, SOC2 evidence checklist)?
- Cost: can you send a range for Tranche A (min/max month) and the expected burn during evaluation vs prod?

We can meet Wed 2025-06-11 at 10am PT to run through the checklist. Also finance has a planned system upgrade the week of 2025-07-06 — if we need a PO earlier that could be a blocker.

Thanks for the quick reply, Alyssa — answers inline and a tighter ask so procurement can prep.

Lead time (Dedicated vs Private):
- Dedicated pool (cloud-backed, fastest): provisioning for a 20-GPU standing pool typically takes 5–7 business days after commit + billing setup.
- Private (VPC/on-prem): lead time depends on KMS and network approvals; typical window is 4–6 weeks from signed SOW for standard VPC deployments; on-prem adds vendor procurement and can extend to 8–12 weeks.

Acceptance gating (minimal):
- Networking: VPC peering and CIDR approval (sample config attached in commit_checklist.md).
- Security: KMS integration test; initial SOC2 evidence package (we can provide the standard binder).
- Performance: baseline eval run (2-day perf test) hitting 90% of your target throughput with 95th pct latency within 20% of target.

Cost preview (Tranche A):
- Evaluation (4 weeks, burst-enabled): $12k–$18k (usage-driven).
- Committed Dedicated monthly run-rate (20 GPU equiv): $45k–$60k depending on reserved vs shared instance mix.
- If you move to Private/on-prem, add one-time setup estimate: $30k–$50k depending on KMS/HSM work.

Proposed tightened MAP and asks (calendar):
- 2025-06-11: MAP review meeting (confirmed Wed 10am PT).
- 2025-06-18: Finalize SOW draft and sizing assumptions (we'll circulate).
- 2025-06-24: Target PO/commit for Tranche A to get provisioning into the July queue.
- 2025-08-01: Tranche B commit deadline to achieve full production ramp in Sept.

If finance has a blackout week during 2025-07-06 we should aim to have the PO signed before then — that is the reason for the 6/24 target. If you can't meet the PO date, we can offer a short-term hosted backup and pre-reserve burst credits at a small premium to protect the schedule.

I've attached a commit_checklist.md with the minimal doc set procurement will ask for and the VPC sample snippet. Ben — can you confirm the perf test harness and acceptance duration?

—Jonas

Jonas Weber
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
